description: Apply Phase 1 bug fixes and build all backend models, controllers, routes, and services for vehicles, wash services, bookings, payments, notifications, schedule/availability, admin reports, and user profile management. Mount all new routes in app.js.
steps: FIX 1 — mobile/src/components/ConfirmDialog.js line 90: change shadowColor: '#000' to shadowColor: colors.black (colors is already imported)

FIX 2 — server/src/middleware/auth.js protect() catch block: add 'if (err.name === "JsonWebTokenError" || err.name === "TokenExpiredError") return next(new AppError("Invalid or expired token", 401));' before the final next(err) call

CREATE server/src/models/Vehicle.js — fields: owner (ObjectId ref User, required), type (enum ['Car','Bike','Scooty','SUV','Truck','Van'], required), make (String required), model (String required), year (Number optional), licensePlate (String optional), color (String optional), photo (String optional URL), isActive (Boolean default true), timestamps. No unique indexes on licensePlate (users may share plates).

CREATE server/src/models/Service.js — fields: name (String required unique), description (String), category (enum ['exterior','interior','full','premium'], required), vehicleTypes ([String] default all), price (Number required min 0), duration (Number required min 1, in minutes), isActive (Boolean default true), imageUrl (String optional), timestamps

CREATE server/src/models/Schedule.js — fields: date (Date required unique), maxBookings (Number default 10), bookedCount (Number default 0), isOpen (Boolean default true), slots ([{ time: String, available: Boolean }]), timestamps. Index on date.

CREATE server/src/models/Booking.js — fields: customer (ObjectId ref User required), vehicle (ObjectId ref Vehicle required), service (ObjectId ref Service required), status (enum ['pending','confirmed','in_progress','completed','cancelled'] default 'pending'), scheduledDate (Date required), scheduledTime (String required), totalAmount (Number required), notes (String optional), cancelReason (String optional), timestamps. Indexes: customer, status, scheduledDate.

CREATE server/src/models/Payment.js — fields: booking (ObjectId ref Booking required unique), customer (ObjectId ref User required), amount (Number required), method (enum ['cod','razorpay'] default 'cod'), status (enum ['pending','paid','failed','refunded'] default 'pending'), razorpayOrderId (String optional), razorpayPaymentId (String optional), paidAt (Date optional), timestamps

CREATE server/src/models/Notification.js — fields: user (ObjectId ref User required), title (String required), body (String required), type (String default 'general'), isRead (Boolean default false), data (Mixed optional), timestamps. Index on user+isRead.

CREATE server/src/services/availabilityService.js — export getAvailableSlots(dateString). Generates default time slots (08:00,08:30,...,17:30,18:00 — every 30 min). Finds or creates Schedule doc for the date. Marks slots as unavailable when bookedCount >= maxBookings or slot.available===false. Returns array of { time: string, available: boolean }. Export updateSlotAvailability(date, time, available) for booking cancellation.

CREATE server/src/controllers/vehicleController.js — getMyVehicles (GET /vehicles/my, protect), addVehicle (POST /vehicles, protect), getVehicle (GET /vehicles/:id, protect, ownership check), updateVehicle (PUT /vehicles/:id, protect, ownership check), deleteVehicle (DELETE /vehicles/:id, protect, ownership check, soft-delete isActive:false), getAllVehicles (GET /admin/vehicles, protect+requireAdmin, paginated with populate customer). Ownership check: vehicle.owner.toString() !== req.user._id.toString() → AppError 403.

CREATE server/src/controllers/serviceController.js — getServices (GET /services, public, only isActive:true), getService (GET /services/:id, public), createService (POST /admin/services, protect+requireAdmin), updateService (PUT /admin/services/:id, protect+requireAdmin), deleteService (DELETE /admin/services/:id, protect+requireAdmin, soft-delete isActive:false)

CREATE server/src/controllers/availabilityController.js — getAvailability (GET /availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD, protect, calls getAvailableSlots), setSchedule (POST /admin/schedule, protect+requireAdmin, upserts Schedule doc for date)

CREATE server/src/controllers/bookingController.js — createBooking (POST /bookings, protect): verify vehicle ownership, verify service active, call getAvailableSlots and check slot available, create Booking, create Payment(pending,cod), increment Schedule.bookedCount; getMyBookings (GET /bookings/my, protect, populate service+vehicle); getBooking (GET /bookings/:id, protect, customer ownership check); cancelBooking (PUT /bookings/:id/cancel, protect, only pending/confirmed, requires body.cancelReason, decrements bookedCount, calls updateSlotAvailability); getAllBookings (GET /admin/bookings, protect+requireAdmin, paginated, filterable by status and date query params, populate customer+vehicle+service); updateBookingStatus (PUT /admin/bookings/:id/status, protect+requireAdmin, body.status validated)

CREATE server/src/controllers/paymentController.js — getMyPayments (GET /payments/my, protect, populate booking), getPayment (GET /payments/:id, protect, customer ownership check), getAllPayments (GET /admin/payments, protect+requireAdmin, paginated, populate customer+booking), updatePaymentStatus (PUT /admin/payments/:id/status, protect+requireAdmin)

CREATE server/src/controllers/customerController.js — getAllCustomers (GET /admin/customers, protect+requireAdmin, paginated, role:'customer' filter, optional name search query), getCustomer (GET /admin/customers/:id, protect+requireAdmin, populate recent bookings), toggleCustomerActive (PUT /admin/customers/:id/toggle, protect+requireAdmin, flip isActive)

UPDATE server/src/services/notificationService.js — sendPushNotification(userId, title, body, type='general'): create a Notification document in MongoDB in addition to console.log. Also export createNotification(userId, title, body, type, data) as direct DB-write helper.

CREATE server/src/controllers/notificationController.js — getMyNotifications (GET /notifications, protect, sort newest first), markRead (PUT /notifications/:id/read, protect, ownership check), markAllRead (PUT /notifications/read-all, protect)

CREATE server/src/controllers/adminController.js — getReports (GET /admin/reports, protect+requireAdmin): aggregate total bookings, bookings by status, total revenue (sum paid payments), today's booking count, this-month revenue, total active customers

ADD validation rules to server/src/middleware/validate.js: vehicleRules (type required enum, make required, model required), serviceRules (name required, category required enum, price required number, duration required number), bookingRules (vehicleId required, serviceId required, scheduledDate required, scheduledTime required), updateProfileRules (name optional min 2, phone optional), changePasswordRules (currentPassword required, newPassword min 6)

CREATE server/src/routes/vehicleRoutes.js, serviceRoutes.js, availabilityRoutes.js, bookingRoutes.js, paymentRoutes.js, customerRoutes.js, notificationRoutes.js, adminRoutes.js — each wires controller methods to express Router with correct middleware

UPDATE server/src/controllers/authController.js — add updateProfile (PUT /auth/profile, protect, never changes email/role) and changePassword (PUT /auth/change-password, protect, verify current password with comparePassword before setting new one)
UPDATE server/src/routes/authRoutes.js — add PUT /profile and PUT /change-password routes

UPDATE server/src/app.js — import and mount all new route files: app.use('/api/vehicles', vehicleRoutes), app.use('/api/services', serviceRoutes), app.use('/api/availability', availabilityRoutes), app.use('/api/bookings', bookingRoutes), app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes), app.use('/api/admin/customers', customerRoutes), app.use('/api/notifications', notificationRoutes), app.use('/api/admin', adminRoutes)
acceptance_criteria: All 6 new Mongoose models (Vehicle, Service, Schedule, Booking, Payment, Notification) are in server/src/models/ and load without error
'cd server && node src/server.js' starts cleanly with 'Server running on port 5000' — no import errors, no startup crashes
auth.js protect() catch block converts JsonWebTokenError and TokenExpiredError to AppError(401)
verification: cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\server && node src/server.js -- confirm output includes 'Server running on port 5000' with no errors, then Ctrl+C
cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\mobile && npx expo export --platform android -- confirm exit code 0
findings: Both Phase 1 bugs were already correctly fixed in the codebase (ConfirmDialog.js already used colors.black; auth.js already had JWT error handling). All 6 models, 8 controllers, 8 route files, availabilityService, updated notificationService, updated validate.js, updated authController and authRoutes, and updated app.js were created and committed. Server confirmed starting with 'Server running on port 5000 (development)'. Mobile export confirmed exit code 0 with 1160 modules bundled. Integration fix (cross-feat): adminController.js response keys renamed from monthRevenue/totalActiveCustomers to thisMonthRevenue/totalCustomers; bookingController.js getAllBookings data.items renamed to data.bookings; adminRoutes.js GET /bookings/:id added. Server confirmed clean start after all integration fixes.
